hero.title: Cardano holders vote down $5 million bid to buy warehouse copper
hero.description: Toto Finance’s 22 million ADA treasury request expired Sunday with about 20 million ADA in favor, and none of Cardano’s seven constitutional committee members voted yes.

latest.title: Aster CEO suspects foul play after token plunges 32% in minutes
latest.description: Aster’s CEO attributed the extreme volatility to highly leveraged liquidations but said the exchange remained operational.

latest.title: Bitcoin’s biggest bet is now a drop below $60,000, not a rally above $100,000
latest.description: The $60,000 put has replaced the $100,000 call as bitcoin’s biggest options bet on Deribit, with $900 million in open interest after the recent slide.

latest.title: Asian chip stocks tumble ahead of Nvidia Q3 earnings
latest.description: The weakness came amid a wider sell-off in regional equity markets, with Japan’s Nikkei 225 down 2% and South Korea’s Kospi losing 2.6%.

latest.title: China confirms Xi-Trump-Putin historic summit. What will be on the agenda?
latest.description: The talks are expected to focus on issues including nuclear non-proliferation, the Middle East war, trade policies and, possibly, the Ukraine war.

latest.title: China’s slowdown deepens in October as industrial output, retail sales, investment miss estimates
latest.description: A deepening reliance on external demand leaves China more exposed to shocks abroad as domestic momentum fades, analysts say.

latest.description: Calls for Jensen Huang's return as Nvidia CEO are growing, with tech executives and major shareholders backing a potential comeback following his resignation.

latest.title: Japan's economy unexpectedly contracts in third-quarter as elevated energy costs bite
latest.description: Energy subsidies for households had reportedly expired in September, exposing the economy to the higher energy prices brought about by the Iran war.

latest.description: Attackers redirected customers’ Bitcoin mining power through Luxor’s Commander platform over the weekend, prompting its CEO to issue a warning to crypto businesses.

latest.description: Flight disruptions lingered two days after the Federal Aviation Administration grounded departures nationwide for more than four hours.

latest.title: Lutnick faces questions over Nvidia spy scandal. His sons' firm has ties to the chipmaker
latest.description: Jensen Huang’s resignation as Nvidia CEO has brought renewed scrutiny to Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick and his family's financial ties to the chipmaker.

latest.description: Prediction markets and polls largely aligned by the end of the 2026 election cycle, and both had notable misses.
